# smsq

## NAME

**smsq**

## SYNOPSIS

`smsq [OPTIONS]`

## DESCRIPTION

Find Steam game servers through the Web API, legacy master-server UDP, or an authenticated Steam Connection Manager session.
The Web API command is the default and is recommended for most queries.

## OPTIONS

### Filter options

|Option|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`-r`, `--raw-filter`|Raw Steam filter expression; an embedded AppID takes precedence over --app-id|no|
|`-f`, `--filter`|Add an include filter as key=value|no|
|`-x`, `--nor`|Exclude servers matching any supplied condition; incompatible with --nand|no|
|`-X`, `--nand`|Exclude servers matching all supplied conditions; incompatible with --nor|no|
|`-i`, `--app-id`|Steam application ID; required unless included in --raw-filter|no|

### Query options

|Option|Description|Default|Required|
|---|---|---|---|
|`-l`, `--limit`|Maximum number of unique servers to return|`25`|no|
|`-t`, `--timeout`|Maximum duration of the complete operation|`2m`|no|

### Output options

|---|---|---|---|

|`-o`, `--output`|Write output to a file instead of stdout||no|
|`-c`, `--columns`|Select output fields; all includes fields available for this protocol and hides empty or zero fields; choices: `address, players, map, name, version, gamedir, os, gametype, bots, gameport, secure, all`|`address, players, map, name`|no|
|`-p`, `--pretty`|Indent JSON output; YAML uses block format by default||no|

### grpc

Query server lists through an authenticated Steam CM session

Query Steam's game-server browser through an authenticated Steam Connection Manager session using protobuf over WebSocket.
MasterServerQuery returns server addresses and available metadata. Despite the command name, this does not use standard gRPC.

**Usage:** `smsq [OPTIONS] grpc [grpc-OPTIONS]`

#### Examples

Authenticate with mobile QR approval and cache the refresh token

```shell
smsq grpc --app-id 730 --auth-mode qr --token-file ./.steam-token.json --limit 10000
```

Collect addresses using a saved Steam Connection Manager discovery plan

```shell
smsq grpc --app-id 730 --plan-in plan.json --records addresses --limit 120000
```

#### Discovery plan files

|Option|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`--plan-in`|Collect results using a saved Discovery plan|no|
|`--plan-out`|Save the generated Discovery plan; only applies when Discovery runs|no|

#### Authentication

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`-m`, `--auth-mode`|Steam authentication: QR approval, Steam Guard code, or mobile approval; choices: `qr, code, approve`|`qr`||no|
|`-a`, `--account`|Steam account name for password-based login||`$STEAM_ACCOUNT`|no|
|`--device-name`|Device name shown during Steam login|`smsq`||no|

#### Token storage

|Option|Description|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|
|`--token-file`|Read and update a plaintext refresh-token file; omit to keep the token in memory|`$STEAM_TOKEN_FILE`|no|

#### Discovery

|Option|Description|Default|Required|
|---|---|---|---|
|`--records`|Return full server records or addresses only; choices: `full, addresses`|`full`|no|
|`--max-requests`|Maximum CM Discovery requests; 0 derives the budget from --limit||no|
|`--max-depth`|Maximum recursive Discovery split depth; 0 uses the default||no|

#### Steam Connection Manager connection

|Option|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`--cm-endpoint`|Use this Steam CM host:port instead of looking up endpoints from Steam|no|
|`--request-interval`|Minimum delay between Discovery request starts after the initial burst; 0 disables pacing|no|
|`--initial-burst`|Number of initial Discovery requests sent without pacing; 0 disables the burst|no|

### rest

Query server lists through the Steam Web API

List Steam game servers through IGameServersService/GetServerList.
One request returns at most 10,000 records. Larger limits, Discovery options, or a saved plan use the Discovery workflow.

**Usage:** `smsq [OPTIONS] rest [rest-OPTIONS]`

#### Examples

Query server addresses with the Web API

```shell
smsq rest --app-id 730 --api-key '<KEY>' --limit 500 --records addresses
```

Discover beyond the 10,000-row API limit and save its plan

```shell
smsq rest --app-id 730 --api-key '<KEY>' --limit 120000 --plan-out plan.json --records addresses
```

Collect using a saved plan

```shell
smsq rest --app-id 730 --api-key '<KEY>' --plan-in plan.json --limit 120000
```

#### Query server lists through the Steam Web API

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`-k`, `--api-key`|Steam Web API key; alternatively set STEAM_API_KEY||`$STEAM_API_KEY`|yes|
|`--records`|Return full server records or addresses only; choices: `full, addresses`|`full`||no|

#### Discovery plan files

|Option|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`--plan-in`|Collect results using a saved Discovery plan|no|
|`--plan-out`|Save the generated Discovery plan; only applies when Discovery runs|no|

#### Discovery limits

|Option|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`--max-requests`|Maximum Web API requests used by Discovery; 0 derives the budget from --limit|no|
|`--max-plan-queries`|Maximum query leaves in the plan; 0 derives the value from --limit|no|
|`--max-buffered-records`|Maximum sample records retained for split validation; 0 uses the default|no|
|`--max-depth`|Maximum recursive split depth; 0 uses the default|no|
|`--min-value-count`|Ignore split values with fewer sample records; 0 uses the default|no|

### udp

Query server addresses through legacy master-server UDP

Query one or more legacy Steam master servers.
Results are deduplicated across masters; collection stops when the servers are exhausted, --limit is reached, or --max-pages stops a master.

**Usage:** `smsq [OPTIONS] udp [udp-OPTIONS]`

#### Examples

Query a legacy master server

```shell
smsq udp --app-id 10 --master master.example.net:27011 --limit 1000
```

Combine include and exclude filters

```shell
smsq udp --app-id 10 --master master.example.net:27011 --filter map=de_dust2 --nor password=1
```

Pass a raw filter expression without CLI validation

```shell
smsq udp --app-id 10 --master master.example.net:27011 --raw-filter '\map\de_dust2'
```

#### Query server addresses through legacy master-server UDP

|Option|Description|Default|Required|
|---|---|---|---|
|`--master`|Steam master server address (host:port)||yes|
|`--io-timeout`|Timeout for each UDP request|`1s`|no|
|`--max-pages`|Maximum pages to read from each master; 0 means no page cap||no|
|`--region`|Legacy geographic region code (0-255; 255 requests all regions)|`0`|no|

## Filter keys

Use these keys with `--filter`, `--nor`, and `--nand`. Filter behavior may vary by protocol and game.

### Flag filters

Binary flag operands accept `0`/`1`, `true`/`false`, `yes`/`no`, or `y`/`n`.

* `dedicated=1`: Dedicated servers; 0 selects non-dedicated servers
* `empty=1`: Servers with players; 0 selects servers with no players
* `full=1`: Servers below capacity; 0 selects full servers
* `linux=1`: Linux servers; 0 selects non-Linux servers
* `noplayers=1`: Servers with zero players; 0 selects servers with players
* `notfull=1`: Select servers below reported capacity; Steam ignores the operand
* `password=1`: Password-protected servers; 0 selects servers without a password
* `proxy=1`: Proxy servers; 0 selects non-proxy servers
* `secure=1`: VAC-protected servers; 0 selects servers without VAC protection
* `white=1`: Servers with whitelist enabled; 0 selects servers with it disabled

### Value filters

* `gameaddr=192.0.2.1:27015`: Match this exact game address
* `gamedata=tag1`: Match a hidden game-data tag
* `gamedir=cstrike`: Match the game's directory identifier
* `gametype=battleye`: Match a server tag (sv_tags)
* `map=de_dust2`: Match the server's map name
* `name_match=*server*`: Match the server name using wildcards
* `napp=10`: Exclude this Steam application ID
* `version_match=1.3.*`: Match the game version using wildcards
